techParks.name: Embassy GolfLinks Business Park
techParks.locality: Challaghatta / Domlur, Koramangala-Indiranagar Intermediate Ring Road
techParks.developer: Embassy Group (Embassy Office Parks REIT holds a 50% interest)
techParks.description: A 37.11-acre low-rise campus beside the Karnataka Golf Association course at Challaghatta, off the Intermediate Ring Road between Domlur and Koramangala. Its blocks are named after golf courses (Augusta, Cherry Hills, Cinnabar Hills, Crystal Downs, Cypress Point, Pacific Dunes, Pebble Beach, Pine Valley, Pinehurst, St. Andrews / Signature, Sunningdale, Sunriver, Torrey Pines) and OSM records them individually. Embassy REIT reports 3.4 msf of leasable area (3.1 msf completed), 100% occupancy and 30 occupiers; a Hilton hotel sits inside the park. WeWork runs centres in Cherry Hills, Sunriver and GolfLinks blocks. Yahoo (R&D closed 2014) and Microsoft (now at Ferns Galaxy, Vigyan and Bagmane Capital per its own page) were historic occupiers and are not listed as current tenants.

techParks.name: Diamond District
techParks.description: A late-1990s mixed-use estate on HAL Old Airport Road at Kodihalli: residential towers around a commercial block (Towers A-D) that has long housed startups and tech offices. OSM records Gojek's India engineering centre, Zeta, the NASSCOM 10,000 Startups warehouse (Tower D) and a BHive coworking centre here; Zoomcar's registered office was Tower B, 7th floor before it moved to Anjaneya Techno Park next door, and apna was recorded here before listing an Ejipura address. OSM tags the operator as IBC Group, which could not be verified.

techParks.name: Divyasree Greens
techParks.description: A mid-size office campus on the Intermediate Ring Road immediately west of Embassy GolfLinks, on survey numbers 12/1, 12/2A and 13/1A of Challaghatta village. Atlassian's own contact page places its Bengaluru office on the 4th and 5th floors; OSM also records a Dell India office in the compound.

techParks.name: RMZ Titanium
techParks.description: A single RMZ office tower at 135 HAL Old Airport Road opposite Manipal Hospital. OSM records FICO (Fair Isaac India), GKN Aerospace, Hyder Consulting, InterCall, AmiCorp and (historically) CA Technologies here; none of these tenancies could be confirmed on a company page, so they are low-confidence.

techParks.name: Anjaneya Techno Park
techParks.description: A small commercial building (No. 147) on HAL Old Airport Road beside Diamond District. Zoomcar Holdings' SEC filings give 'Anjaneya Techno Park, No. 147, 1st Floor, Kodihalli' as its business address.

techParks.name: Golf View Campus
techParks.description: A cluster of three office towers plus an IndiQube managed-office centre on NAL Wind Tunnel Road at Murugeshpalya, behind the HAL Old Airport Road frontage. Enphase Energy's India office is at IndiQube Golf View Homes per its own contact page; OSM also records nference, Ipsos, DDB Mudra, ansrsource and (historically) Omega Healthcare here.

coverageNotes: Method: the shared WebSearch budget was exhausted before this lens started, so verification relied on the offline OSM extracts (484 office POIs and 90 commercial/industrial tracts inside lat 12.94-12.99, lng 77.62-77.68), the geocoder, and direct WebFetch of company contact/location pages, Embassy REIT's EGL page, SEC EDGAR and Wikipedia. CONFIRMED on a primary page: EGL (3.4 msf, 37.11 acres, 30 occupiers, 100% occupied), Dell (Crystal Downs), Fidelity, Roku (St. Andrews), Cushman & Wakefield (Pine Valley), OpenText (Infinity Domlur + WeWork Cherry Hills + two Bagmane blocks), Atlassian (Divyasree Greens), Enphase (IndiQube Golf View), Sasken, Mistral, Accord, Postman, Pixxel, Niqo Robotics, Zoomcar (SEC), NAL, Microsoft (three offices, none at EGL), [24]7.ai, Ather, Scripbox, Vedantu, Plivo, apna. OSM-only (medium/low): IBM, Target, McAfee, PwC, FICO, Truecaller, Goldman Sachs, Unacademy, Zeta, nference, Gojek (plus Wikipedia), CRED's three buildings, HealthifyMe. A single OSM mapper in late 2023 added company nodes across EGL including Yahoo (gone since 2014), so those 2023 nodes (Goldman, Microsoft, [24]7, IBM, Fidelity) were treated as stale unless a company page agreed; Microsoft's page lists no EGL office, so Microsoft EGL is excluded as a pre-2023 exit, and Goldman is kept only as low confidence. LEFT OUT from the lens hint because no office in the lens could be substantiated or the company's own page places it elsewhere: Yahoo (Bengaluru R&D closed 2014), SuperValu (exited), ANZ, Lowe's, Nokia/Alcatel-Lucent (all Manyata, other lens), Mercedes-Benz R&D and Tesco (Whitefield), Mphasis and Mindtree/LTIMindtree (Mahadevapura / Global Village), Visa and LinkedIn (ORR/Whitefield), Fiserv, Swiggy (Embassy TechVillage), Bounce (JP Nagar per OSM), Simpl (getsimpl.com now a parking page), Yulu (HQ Bengaluru but no address found), Licious (no address found). Scripbox, Vedantu, Plivo and Ather were in the hint but their verified offices are outside the lens; they are included as overlap. Also left out: VC firms Peak XV/Sequoia (OSM: 278 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar), Lightspeed and Elevation Capital (Ecoworld) because none of the four categories fits a fund; Omega Healthcare (OSM at Golf View Campus, but its own site now gives Chennai as India HQ); Moonfrog, YourStory, Routematic, Knolskape, Stylumia, Hasgeek, DeepSource, Zapr (site dead) and other small Indiranagar firms; DRDO labs (GTRE, LRDE, ADE, CAIR), C-DAC, Britannia's old Old Airport Road HQ (moved 2020), and coworking operators (WeWork, IndiQube, 91springboard, BHive, 315Work Avenue). Bagmane Tech Park tenants and Koramangala 6th Block firms (Juspay) that fell inside the bounding box belong to other lenses and were skipped. Coordinates: EGL blocks and Diamond District use OSM building POIs; HAL/ISRO/NAL/BEML use OSM landuse polygons; Dunzo uses the Indiranagar locality centroid; Pixxel's HBR Layout point is decoded from the company's own plus code. HAL's Cubbon Road corporate office, BEML Soudha, ISRO's Antariksh Bhavan and Goldman's Bellandur campus could not be geocoded and are omitted. No headcounts by city were found except NAL's ~2,500 staff.
